evaluation_mode_justification: Every requested value is a fixed calculation from local event-window dates, report text flags, physical summaries, surface statistics, and stated thresholds.

evidence_roles.event_anchor: dust family, visibility/air-quality wording, date window, and Iraq/Mesopotamia location
evidence_roles.point_hydromet: package point-weather countermetrics for rain, heat, and wind-only alternatives
evidence_roles.regional_summaries: regional precipitation, temperature, and wind countermetric context

primary_gt.rule: dust>=7 and margin>=4 with rainfall, heat, and surface gates below threshold

provenance.notes: All numeric anchors are regenerated from local CSX-304 package files.

criteria.description: Returns the requested six top-level JSON fields with nested metric groups and final label.
criteria.name: Output schema
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a recoverable object with one missing field or inconsistent rounding.

criteria.description: Computes regional precipitation mean near 5.8182 mm, point-to-regional ratio near 9.262, and the regional rainfall gate states.
criteria.name: Hydrometeorological arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-4 points for correct extraction with one arithmetic or gate error.

criteria.description: Computes maximum temperature near 34.59 C, margin near 0.41 C, and surface_change_max near 0.070014 with threshold states.
criteria.name: Temperature and surface thresholds
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two of the three threshold checks.

criteria.description: Applies all five component-score formulas and reports scores 8, 2, 0, 1, and 0.
criteria.name: Component scores
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per mostly correct score group, up to 3 points for four groups.

criteria.description: Computes score_margin = 6 and applies all final gates to get the pass label.
criteria.name: Final threshold rule
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right label with one missing gate or margin error.

criteria.description: Keeps the consequence label concise and directly tied to the threshold result.
criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct label with extra narration.

criteria.description: Does not add measured health burden, direct damage, or operational advice beyond the computed values.
criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for one minor extra inference that does not alter the result.
